new_lens_seeds.title: Taboo As No-Exit Solidarity
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A group can create commitment by crossing a forbidden line so publicly that outside hatred, shared guilt, and fear of betrayal make retreat impossible.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The lecture applies the mechanism to military metaphor, public sacrifice, Monkey Island, school pranks, theft, Spartan formation, and metaphysical evil, and the current public Taboo page already carries it as a stable parent-page mechanism.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create a child page now. The Taboo parent is compact and already uses the mechanism as its definition spine; a child would duplicate `taboo-river-removes-retreat` unless future source fan-in creates a separate hover surface.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-08-29, this lecture sits between the September 2024 ritual-balance primitive and later December 2025 Frankism / modern scapegoat sources. It supplies the first public-read spine where taboo is explicitly named as a river that removes retreat.

The lecture explicitly warns that its theories are tools, not doctrine. Later public use should keep that caveat visible, especially around Gaza, sacrifice, incest, Satan, and metaphysical evil claims.

The late Dante section changes register: evil is no longer only the strategic energy of taboo breach but the denial of the Monad, love, free will, and the spiritual world. Route that register through Free Will, Human Heart, Dead World, or Poetry by active mechanism rather than expanding Taboo.
